name: poof
description: System-wide text expander for macOS. Type a curated /trigger in any app and it expands to your text.
author: Nick Villapiano <nvillapiano@gmail.com>

scripts.build:full: npm run build && npm run migrate
scripts.release: git push origin main && git tag v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && git push origin v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
scripts.release:patch: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8')),v=p.version.split('.').map(Number);v[2]++;p.version=v.join('.');fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2)+'\n');" && SHORT=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version.split('.').slice(0,2).join('.')") && /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Set :CFBundleShortVersionString $SHORT" Resources/Info.plist && git add package.json Resources/Info.plist && git commit -m "chore: bump version to $(node -p \"require('./package.json').version\")" && npm run release
